data.name: Farm Of Hope
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated


About the Game

Across the dry lands of rural Africa, many people and organizations came with temporary aid.

Food was delivered.
Supplies were handed out.
Then everything slowly disappeared again.

But But you are here to do something different. You are here to bring lasting life, civilization, and self-sufficiency.

Inspired by the real humanitarian journey of Quang Linh and his African volunteer team, Farm Of Hope is a cozy farming and community-building simulation about helping a village grow through hard work, kindness, and sustainable farming.

You are not here to save the world overnight.

You are here to plant the first seeds of hope.

🌱 TURN DRY LAND INTO A THRIVING COMMUNITY

Start your journey in a small village surrounded by drought, poor soil, and empty water tanks.

Together with the local community, you will slowly transform the land through farming, irrigation, education, and cooperation.

Plant crops.
Raise animals.
Dig wells.
Build a future.

Watch the environment evolve from dry dust into vibrant green life.

  • Grow corn, cassava, pineapple, rice, and vegetables

  • Build irrigation systems and water wells

  • Raise livestock and expand local food production

  • Restore abandoned land and create sustainable farms

  • Help villages survive harsh dry seasons

Every harvest changes lives.

💧 BUILD HOPE, ONE STEP AT A TIME

In Farm Of Hope, progress is not measured only by money.

It is measured by the people around you.

Feel the joy of seeing clean water finally reach a village for the first time.
See children return to school after successful harvest seasons.
Watch small homes grow into a lively community filled with music, markets, and celebration.

As the village grows, new stories, characters, and opportunities begin to appear.

🤝 GROW TOGETHER WITH THE COMMUNITY

This is not a story about charity.

This is a story about people working together to build a better future.

Work side-by-side with villagers to:

  • Learn and improve farming techniques

  • Expand food production together

  • Create local businesses and trade

  • Build schools, homes, and community spaces

  • Develop a self-sustaining rural economy

The stronger the community becomes, the more the world around you changes.

🌍 INSPIRED BY REAL HUMANITARIAN STORIES

Farm Of Hope draws inspiration from the real-life activities of Quang Linh Team in Africa — supporting local communities through agriculture, well building, education, and long-term development.

Not through miracles.
Not through politics.
But through persistence, compassion, and everyday effort.

✨ A COZY AND MEANINGFUL FARMING EXPERIENCE

  • Relaxing farming and village-building gameplay

  • Warm, emotional progression

  • Beautiful environments inspired by rural Africa

  • Dynamic village growth and transformation

  • Wholesome storytelling and memorable characters

  • A peaceful experience focused on hope and community

This is more than a farming simulator.

It is a journey about rebuilding hope together.

🌅 ONE SMALL FARM CAN CHANGE EVERYTHING

A single seed can feed a family.
A single well can change a village.
A single community can inspire the world.

Wishlist Farm Of Hope and begin your journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for best performance
